description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio and Minion Reflector.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Minion Reflector trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Burning-Tree Emissary with haste.
The Burning-Tree Emissary token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Burning-Tree Emissary trigger, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Burning-Tree Emissary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
